Grading by fluid depth: less than 10mm small, 10 to 25 moderate, not below 25 large; by location it is divided into testicular, spermatic cord and communicating types (reduces when supine).

map.透光试验意义？: What does the transillumination test mean?
map.阳性（透光）支持鞘膜积液/精液囊肿，阴性需警惕疝或肿瘤，结合超声定位。: A positive (translucent) result supports hydrocele or spermatocele; a negative result warrants vigilance for hernia or tumor, with ultrasound for localization.
map.交通性和非交通性怎么区分？: How to distinguish communicating from non-communicating?
map.交通性鞘膜积液与腹腔相通，站立、哭闹或活动后增大，平卧后可缩小；非交通性大小基本: A communicating hydrocele connects with the abdominal cavity and enlarges on standing, crying or activity, then shrinks when supine; a non-communicating one is essentially fixed in size. Marked positional change usually means a communicating type (equivalent to a hernia); the rate of spontaneous resolution with conservative observation is low, so high ligation surgery is usually recommended.
